agents.title: Agents on trial
agents.help: The Fabric data agents being evaluated. Pick one to see the questions the jury has proposed for it.

caseBoard.title: Cases
caseBoard.help: Questions for this agent with the answers the jury expects. Each column shows how far the jury has got in agreeing on an answer.

caseDetail.title: Case
caseDetail.help: One question and the expected answers proposed for it, each with the definition its author used.

caseValidity.unverifiedHelp: Written by someone who is not on the jury. It is shown but never used in a hearing.

expert.label: Expert
expert.description: proposes cases and answers, and votes on them

approver.label: Approver
approver.description: also confirms rulings: a case needs an approver's vote to be ruled

admin.label: Admin
admin.description: also manages jurors and agents in the clerk's office

home.title: Who judges the judge?
home.help: A jury of business experts agrees on the right answers, so Fabric data agents can be tested against them.
home.empty: The docket opens in the next step: cases, answers and votes will appear here.

clerk.title: Clerk's office
clerk.help: Decide who sits on the jury and which agents stand trial. Every change is checked on the server and written to the admin log.
clerk.protectedBody: The server checks that you are an active admin before saving anything. If it can't confirm it, nothing changes.
clerk.notAdmin: Only active admins can use the clerk's office. Ask an admin if you need access.
clerk.loading: The clerk is fetching the records…

jurors.title: The jury
jurors.caption: Jurors
jurors.footnote: Deactivating keeps everything a juror said in the court record; they just can't vote or propose any more. Nobody is ever deleted.
jurors.emptyActive: No active jurors yet. Swear in the first one with the form.
jurors.emptyInactive: Nobody is inactive. Deactivated jurors appear here.

swearIn.title: Swear in a juror
swearIn.emailHint: Must be the email they use to sign in to Fabric.
swearIn.emailInvalid: Enter a work email such as name@example.com.
swearIn.displayNameHint: Optional. If empty, the part of the email before the @ is shown.
swearIn.teamHint: Optional. Shown next to their name.

latest.title: Latest admin changes
latest.empty: No admin changes yet. They appear here as soon as someone makes one.

agents.title: Agents on trial
agents.help: The Fabric data agents the jury writes cases for. Retiring one keeps its cases and hearings.
agents.empty: No agents yet. Register the first one.

registerAgent.title: Register an agent
registerAgent.name: Agent name
registerAgent.nameHint: How the jury will see it.
registerAgent.idHint: Copy it from the agent's address in Fabric.
registerAgent.invalidId: This must be an ID like 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-…

log.title: Admin log
log.help: Every admin request and its result, including rejected attempts. The record is never edited.
log.caption: Admin log
log.loadError: The admin log could not be loaded.

entry.unknown: {{who}} sent a request the office doesn't know

attempt.readAdminLog: {{who}} tried to open the admin log
attempt.unknown: {{who}} sent a request the office doesn't know

errors.onlyAdmins: Only active admins can do this.
errors.selfProtection: You can't deactivate yourself or remove your own admin role.
errors.jurorExists: This email is already on the jury.
errors.invalid: Some fields are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.notFound: That juror or agent no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.notSignedIn: You need to be signed in to do this.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

errors.load: The data could not be loaded.
errors.save: The change could not be saved. Nothing was lost; try again.
errors.notSignedIn: You need to be signed in to do this.
